samples.material_state: heat-treated (1100 °C/4 h AC + 650 °C/24 h AC + 760 °C/16 h AC)

evidence.quote: The three alloys with 5 wt.%, 15 wt.% and 23 wt.% Co are labeled as Alloy1, Alloy2 and Alloy3, respectively.
For the three alloys, 20-kg ingots were cast using vacuum induction melting (VIM).
These ingots were then hot extruded into 35 mm bars at about 1160 °C.
The extruded samples were heat-treated at 1100 °C/4 h (air cooling)
followed by aging at 650 °C/24 h (air cooling)
